Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 29-Nov-2025 (09:30 AM - 12:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  THIRD SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - NOVEMBER 2025  
  SUBJECT: ECE 2127/EC_ 2127 DIGITAL CIRCUITS  
  (SPL: ELECTRONICS ENGINEERING (VLSI DESIGN AND TECHNOLOGY))  
  DIGITAL CIRCUITS [ECE 2127]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                                    Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1A)               Design a combinational circuit using 4:16 decoder with active-low outputs to convert BCD code to equivalent          (4)  
  XS-3 code.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
1B)               Design a combinational circuit using programmable logic array (PLA) to implement a full subtractor.                  (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
1C)                                                                                                                                          (3)  
  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
2A)               Design a Moore-type circuit using D flip-flops, with one input and one output to detect the occurrences of the       (4)  
  bit pattern 110 in a sequential pulse train.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
2B)               Implement the function f(w, x, y, z) = ∑m (0, 2, 4, 5, 7, 9, 10, 14) using 2-level multiplexer structure             (3)  
  comprising of two 4:1 MUXs and one 2:1 MUX.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
2C)               Using the characteristic equations and excitation table, realize an SR flip-flop using a D flip-flop.                (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
3A)               Design a hazard-free mod-16 asynchronous edge counter by synthesizing a mod-8 pulse counter.                         (4)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
3B)               Using negative edge triggered T flipflops, design mod 14 ripple counter. Also draw the timing diagram.               (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
3C)               Analyze the behavior of a SR flip-flop as an asynchronous sequential circuit using the Moore model. Derive           (3)  
  the state transition table, flow table and state diagram accordingly.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
4A)               Design a synchronous Mod-12 counter using JK flipflops. Draw the timing diagram for the same.                        (4)  
  Page #1

Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
4B)                   Using a universal shift register design a circuit to generate the following sequence: 1001110100111010...      (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
4C)                   Design a sequential circuit to generate the following sequence 101110100111100101110.. using indirect          (3)  
  logic.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
5A)                   Design an optimally state-assigned Mealy synchronous sequential circuit for serial binary adder using JK flip- (4)  
  flops and logic gates.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
5B)                   Plot the timing diagram showing the Q and Q̅ outputs of Master-slave SR flipflop, with the control input C,    (3)  
  based on the given waveform.  
  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
5C)                   Design a synchronous sequential circuit using edge-triggered JK flip-flops to generate the sequence: 0 → 2     (3)  
  → 4 → 3 → 5 → 6 → 0 → 2 → ... Ensure that any invalid or undesired states are redirected to state 3.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"
